scope_guards: A title plan is read with the register and filed documents and is not a standalone exact-boundary instrument.
General-boundary red edging is not treated as the exact legal line or a surveyed coordinate set.
National Polygon Service geometry is indicative index geometry and requires exact title and site binding.
INSPIRE is a registered-freehold subset; absence is not evidence of no leasehold title or no registered interest.
A polygon repeated in two local-authority files is not counted as two titles or two sites.
SIM and illustrative plans identify title numbers and registration context but do not define individual title extents.
Dataset/API availability and monthly publication do not prove that a candidate-specific query was executed.
No score or promotion is written without exact title number, current register, site relation and executed overlays.
